objective: Compute the total available_today_quantity of a specific Metabo Cordless Drill Driver product across all Graz stores, including stores with zero availability.

params.product_sku: lookup from product_variants pv JOIN product_variant_properties pvp ON pv.product_sku = pvp.product_sku WHERE pv.brand = 'Metabo' AND pv.series = 'Metabo Brushless BS 1OW-IK5 Cordless Drill Driver' AND pvp.property_key = 'voltage' AND pvp.property_value_text = '18 V' AND pvp.property_key = 'battery platform' AND pvp.property_value_text = '18v-system' AND pvp.property_key = 'kit contents' AND pvp.property_value_text = 'bare tool'
params.inventory_rows: for each graz_store, lookup from store_inventory WHERE store_id = store.store_id AND product_sku = $product_sku, else treat as 0 available_today_quantity
params.total_available: sum of available_today_quantity across all inventory_rows (including missing as 0)
params.store_record_paths: list of record_path from stores for each graz_store
